== Summary ==
[[Brandon Nguyen]] with his Team Tournament Winner medal from the 2017 tournament, which he won with Team Wisconsin (the medal shows the outline of Wisconsin). Posted on 5 April 2018 (UTC) in the [[2018 Minnesota State Team Tournament]] thread: "Wouldn't mind winning for the 2nd year in a row."

* '''Date posted:''' 2018-04-05
* '''People:''' [[Brandon Nguyen]]
